```{=html}
<div class="ethos-content">
  <div class="content-section">
    <div class="section-divider">
      <span class="section-title">Mission</span>
    </div>
    <p>Our mission is to accelerate the deployment of machines that perceive, reason, and safely interact with the complexities of the physical world. Building robust perception systems is one of the hardest problems in robotics—teams often spend years creating brittle, one-off solutions that are difficult to maintain and extend. We're making this simpler. Our modular AI components and developer platform let companies build, integrate, and control physical AI without starting from scratch.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="content-section">
    <div class="section-divider">
      <span class="section-title">Product</span>
      </div>
      <p>Our perception software tackles real-world sensing challenges with GPU-accelerated, composable components that run directly on-device, requiring no training. They seamlessly integrate with your existing sensors and can be tuned to your environment. The suite includes reliable localization and mapping that works with LiDAR, cameras, radar, and inertial or odometry inputs; automated calibration for precise multi-sensor alignment; and dynamic masking to filter out noise and irrelevant data in real time, ensuring accurate, efficient perception.</p>
    </div>
  <div class="content-section">
    <div class="section-divider">
      <span class="section-title">System</span>
    </div>
    <p>Our system-level capabilities are designed to be smarter together, with coordination interfaces that seamlessly combine modules into robust composite systems capable of intelligently fusing information for optimal decision-making. Every system also includes safe human override functionality, ensuring operators can step in to resolve ambiguity whenever necessary.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="content-section">
    <div class="section-divider">
      <span class="section-title">Platform</span>
    </div>
    <p>Our developer platform unifies the entire workflow, making it easy to operate, monitor, and improve your systems. It provides middleware for sensor capture, synchronization, and publishing; centralized telemetry and observability integration; and an analysis SDK for streamlined evaluation and benchmarking.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
